evals.prompt: Fine-tune a multimodal LLM (GPT-4o class) for our educational assistant. It should handle text questions, diagram analysis, and handwritten math recognition. We have 10,000 labeled examples. Propose a fine-tuning strategy.
evals.expected_output: Proposes LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning approach, defines data preprocessing for each modality, includes validation strategy and overfitting prevention.
assertions: Recommends parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, or adapter tuning)
Defines data preprocessing strategies for each modality (text, diagrams, handwriting)
Includes a validation strategy with holdout set and overfitting detection

evals.prompt: Our fine-tuned model shows 95% accuracy on training data but only 68% on the test set. The model also performs well on a subset of the test data that closely resembles training examples. Diagnose the issue.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses overfitting and likely data leakage, recommends investigation steps, proposes regularization and data audit strategies.
assertions: Identifies the 27% accuracy gap as clear overfitting
Investigates potential data leakage between training and test sets
Proposes specific remediation: regularization, data augmentation, or reduced model complexity

evals.prompt: Compare Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Gemini 1.5 Pro for our educational assistant use case. Key requirements: math reasoning, multilingual support (Spanish/English), cost under $0.01 per student interaction, and low latency.
evals.expected_output: Compares all three on math benchmarks, language support, pricing, latency, with a recommendation based on the specific requirements.
assertions: Compares all three models on math reasoning capability with reference to benchmarks
Analyzes cost per interaction against the $0.01 budget constraint
Evaluates multilingual Spanish/English performance for each model

evals.prompt: We need synthetic training data for a student question classifier. Categories: homework help, concept explanation, exam preparation, emotional support, and off-topic. Generate a strategy for creating 50,000 synthetic examples.
evals.expected_output: Proposes LLM-based generation with diversity controls, defines quality validation pipeline, addresses class balance and bias detection.
assertions: Proposes an LLM-based synthetic data generation approach with diversity controls
Defines a quality validation pipeline to filter low-quality or biased examples
Addresses class balance across all 5 categories

evals.prompt: Design an MLOps pipeline for our educational AI models. We retrain weekly, serve 3 model versions simultaneously, and need A/B testing capability. Current process is entirely manual.
evals.expected_output: Designs end-to-end MLOps pipeline with automated training, model registry, multi-version serving, A/B testing framework, and monitoring.
assertions: Designs automated weekly retraining with data validation gates
Includes a model registry with versioning and multi-version serving
Proposes A/B testing framework with statistical significance monitoring

should_trigger: How should we fine-tune a multimodal LLM for our educational assistant?
Our model has high training accuracy but low test accuracy, what is wrong?
Compare LLM providers for our use case on cost, quality, and latency
